verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents real-time FX conversion, mid-market rates, and converting funds 'when exchange rates are favourable' (jeeves-docs-41), but there is no mention of a rate-lock or hold feature that guarantees a fixed FX rate for a defined window before a transfer completes. missing for 10: explicit rate-lock/forward-rate mechanism, defined lock window/expiry, any documentation of guaranteeing a rate ahead of settlement.
